method: Inspected all 100 named chronological case summaries, their interval ordering, source-clock context and decision/admission-to-first-placement times.

Read selected operational source notes including accepted referral plans, receiving receipts, capacity dispositions and private-room precautions; inspected opening census, terminal/open boundaries, X/UNKNOWN defaults and ICU ward overflow/stepdown.

Reviewed route-dependent transfer assumptions, the 12 maintenance/restoration sequences, source corrections and cancelled holds; complete-history invariants and paired interval/state controls are independently validated.

resolved_findings.resolution: Replace the provisional 26-patient site opening with 19 compatible explicit occupants per site; retain all 57 carry-in patients.
Actual clinical completion responds to bed waits; acute unmet compatible demand has an observed external transfer and source cause, while elective pre-admission deferral preserves original bookings.
Use timestamped selected precaution assessments, private-room placement and conservative defaults for X/UNKNOWN registration values.
Permit actual weekday arrivals 07:00-14:59 under the explicit operational addendum; preserve the standalone clinical validator default and original morning bookings.
Order intervals by actual start time and atomic transfer legs as vacate before occupy; add a regression checking all sampled first-placement labels.
Boarding starts at admission decision. The escalation threshold is separately defined as 24 hours from administrative admission; transport and censored queues are explicitly reported.

Explicitly order encounter revisions and operational source notes so checkpoints, canonical files and reversed input produce identical review text and fact hashes. The approved sample and bound facts remain unchanged.
Use explicit 120/180/240 minute route windows plus zero to thirty minutes of handover; preserve transport when downstream bed waits change and independently validate all 12 transfers.
Twelve source-known accepted referral plans justify network continuity; twelve receiving receipts confirm observed arrival without asserting later outcomes.
Administrative capacity and continuity transfers do not automatically imply clinical deterioration; clinical measurement response uses a separate selected clinical nonresponse cause.

material_assumptions: Fictional small adult hospital network and selected non-exhaustive clinical capture, rather than a full ICU/OR record or national benchmark.
Physical ICU ward overflow does not assert intensive treatment or justify an ICU charge.
External receiving care and later hypothetical terminal outcomes are unobserved and are not published.
Actual workforce, stock, financial ledgers, source release replay and final consumer acceptance remain later phases.
disposition: Operational plausibility approved within this synthetic scope, conditional on the complete technical acceptance gate passing; final data release and solution work remain blocked.
